clips.send: A discouraged founder sends this to a friend mid-failure: anger turned into resolve - proof Rockefeller and Edison counted failures as fuel, not a verdict to quit.
clips.caption:

Thomas Edison failed to build the light bulb 10,000 times. Asked how that felt, his answer was: "I didn't fail 10,000 times. I successfully found 10,000 ways it didn't work."

That is the millionaire mindset Kevin Trudeau teaches: every failure is information, not a verdict. Comment "BRAIN" and I will send you the free training on how to think like this on purpose.
